messages:
nora: Heads-up 1: we need a localization-ready asset bundle for the upcoming webinar and launch posts. One 16:9 slide master, three microtiles for benchmarks, a 600x360 hero thumbnail, and animated GIF hero (max 2MB). Exports in EN + ES + FR. Can design do a single Figma file with language pages?
rachel: Yep. Can you confirm copy lengths per language? Need to plan for layout breaks.
nora: Good call. Use these CMS limits: headline 60 chars, subhead 140 chars, CTA short 20 chars. I'll upload a translations CSV in a sec.
diego: Also need to make sure the benchmark numbers are annotated as "representative" where appropriate. We can't use superlatives.
nora: Correct. Use "low-latency" / "cost-efficient" language. No "best" or "fastest". Marco from legal already okayed the phrasing pattern earlier.
rachel: Copy constraints noted. For GIF, what content? subtle sparkline animation or a crossfade between tiles?
nora: Sparkline anim looks nice for social. Keep it subtle (no flashing), 3 frames loop. Add an accessible pause frame as PNG fallback.
diego: Accessibility checklist: color contrast 4.5:1 for primary body, captions min 14px in final PNGs, alt text for every export.
nora: I'll provide alt text examples and plain-language microcopy for each language. Also need export naming convention e.g., webinar_v1_en_600x360.png.
nora: uploading translation file: https://drive.redwood/launch/translations_launch_webinar.csv (contains en,es,fr; headline/subhead/cta columns).
figma-bot: Created file 'Webinar / Launch Localized Pack' and branch 'localization-4391000000' 1: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/Webinar-Localized-Pack?node-id=0%3A1
rachel: I'll scaffold the file. Plan: components page, tokens (color/typography), a slide master, then language pages. Will include export presets.
diego: Microtiles: need one chart (cost per 1k tokens), one bar (throughput by batch size), one icon diagram (routing fallback). Make SVG + PNG for each.
rachel: For charts do you want gridlines and data labels or a clean minimalist look?
diego: Minimalist, but include hover-state annotations in the figma comments for the speaker to reference. Also add a small footnote with test conditions.
nora: Legal/brand signoff flow: once you push uploads I'll tag @brand-ops and @legal. ETA for first pass?
rachel: I can have a first pass (frames + sample exports) by Wed morning. GIF may be Thu morning.
nora: Perfect. One last ask: include a short copy deck (one-pager) with alt-text snippets and translated microcopy so ops can ingest into the webinar CMS.
rachel: Will add a one-pager frame with CSV-ready columns and alt text fields.
figma-bot: Export presets added to branch 'localization-4391000000' 1: PNG 600x360, 1200x628, 800x800; GIF 600x360 loop; SVG icons.
nora: Thanks team. If you need placeholder numbers for layout use the devbench CSV and mark them as sample. I'll follow up once brand/legal sign-off is needed. :sparkles:
